shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Ordinary English
shared.text: Contemporary general-purpose English in its ordinary, nontechnical senses

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Software, source code, configuration, applications, systems, components, and processes understood as running programs

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Frontends and backends at the level of user-facing and server-side software

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Inputs, outputs, state, errors, failures, and dependencies

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Functions as named software units that accept inputs and produce outputs or effects

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Parameters as named inputs to functions or APIs, and arguments as supplied values

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Interfaces and application programming interfaces (APIs) as defined boundaries between software units

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Clients and servers, requests and responses, and HTTP as a common request protocol

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Files and databases, including tables, rows, and queries at a conceptual level

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic software concepts
shared.text: Latency as delay, throughput as work per unit of time, capacity, and availability

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Software delivery and quality
shared.text: Requirements, acceptance criteria, features, bugs or defects, and regressions

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Software delivery and quality
shared.text: Manual and automated tests, including unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression tests at a purpose level

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Software delivery and quality
shared.text: Reproduction steps and debugging at the level of finding the cause of a failure

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Software delivery and quality
shared.text: Logs, metrics, monitoring, and alerts

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Software delivery and quality
shared.text: Development, test, staging, and production environments

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Software delivery and quality
shared.text: Builds, deployments, releases, versions, and rollbacks

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Software delivery and quality
shared.text: Version control, commits, branches, diffs, pull requests, and code review at a purpose level

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Software delivery and quality
shared.text: Continuous integration at the level of automated checks on a proposed change

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic quantitative reasoning
shared.text: Arithmetic with whole numbers, decimals, negative numbers, and fractions

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic quantitative reasoning
shared.text: Counts, minimums, maximums, and ranges

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic quantitative reasoning
shared.text: Percentages, ratios, and rates

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic quantitative reasoning
shared.text: Mean or average and median

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic quantitative reasoning
shared.text: Chance in its ordinary, informal sense

shared.category: B.1 Assumed concepts — Basic quantitative reasoning
shared.text: Values presented in simple tables, line charts, and bar charts

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Arithmetic: `+ − × /` and parentheses.

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Equality and comparison: `=`, `≠`, `<`, `≤`, `>`, and `≥`.

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Percent `%` and plain ratios such as `3:1`.

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Plain numeric ranges such as `1–5`.

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Variables, named constants, function application, and subscripted indexing

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Approximation `≈`, powers, absolute value, scientific notation, and interval notation such as `[0, 1]`

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Summation `Σ`, product `Π`, logarithms, exponentials, factorial, and Big-O notation

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Set notation, including membership, subsets, unions, intersections, and set-builder notation

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Binomial coefficients `C(n, k)` / `(n choose k)`

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Vector/matrix notation: bold symbols, `Ax`, transpose, norms `‖x‖`, and dot products.

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Calculus notation: `d/dx`, `∂`, `∫`, `∇`, and limits.

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: Probability/statistics notation: `P(X | Y)` as formal notation, `E[·]`, `Var`, `σ`, and distribution names and symbols (`N(μ, σ²)`).

shared.category: B.2 Assumed notation — Included
shared.text: `argmax` / `argmin`, `∝`, `∀` / `∃`, and Greek letters carrying conventional meanings (θ for parameters, α for rates).

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Model (in the machine-learning sense), training, loss, gradient, neural network, layer, weight, activation, embedding, token, attention, and transformer

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Parameter (in the stored-numeric-setting sense), pre-training, fine-tuning, prompt, context window, and inference (in the machine-learning sense)

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Overfitting, regularization, hyperparameter, checkpoint, sampling (in the generation sense), reinforcement learning, reward, agent (in the machine-learning sense), alignment, and hallucination

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Benchmark suites by name (MMLU, GSM8K, …) and dataset names as shorthand (ImageNet, C4, …)

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Mode, percentiles, named distributions, standard deviation, variance, standard error, hypothesis testing, p-values, and statistical significance

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Confidence intervals, effect sizes, correlation, regression, sampling error, statistical power, expected value, and formal probability

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Algebraic manipulation, mathematical functions, function graphs, linear equations, slopes, and polynomials

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Exponentials, logarithms, summation, products, factorials, combinatorics, formal set operations, and coordinate geometry

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Matrix multiplication as an operation with meaning

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Vectors as directions or points in high-dimensional space

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Dot products as similarity

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — The following concepts remain unassumed
shared.text: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors, matrix decompositions, and high-dimensional geometry

shared.category: B.3 Explicitly not assumed — Calculus and optimization
shared.text: Derivatives, partial derivatives, gradients (formal sense), integrals, limits, continuity as a formal property, convexity, optimization as a field, and convergence guarantees
